conviction_note: Honest zero: 29 analysts, public foot-traffic and card-spend reads, a company Q1 EPS cadence guide that already brackets consensus, and a macro fuel shock the skew and the -4.9% 20-day run-up already carry. Once LESSONS was applied, neither draft finding held up as something unpriced that is inside the window.
bar: Q1 FY27 revenue $3.21B and adjusted EPS $2.05-2.06, from two agreeing estimate sources (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/darden-earnings-up-next-can-olive-garden-match-longhorn-93CH-4913242 and https://www.bitget.com/news/detail/12560605833489). Company Q1 guide on the June call was 'low to mid-single digit EPS growth' on $1.97, i.e. about $2.03-2.09 (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-darden-tops-q4-eps-forecast-shares-edge-higher-on-outlook-93CH-4760947), so consensus sits inside the company's own guide. Street brand bars: Olive Garden SRS +1.8%, LongHorn +5.9%, blended +3.1%. Published cuts take Olive Garden down to +0.9% (Oppenheimer), +1.3% (KeyBanc) and +1.5% (Morgan Stanley).
positioning_check: Short interest 3.86% of float, 3.6 days to cover (fintel, snippet only, settlement date not given, searched 2026-09-23; https://fintel.io/ss/us/dri, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/dri/statistics/). That is not crowded. The 25-delta skew is +5.89 vol points, so downside is paid. Put/call OI is 0.41. Event-implied move is 4.62% against a median own-print reaction of 1.85%.
searched_and_found_nothing: Placer.ai foot traffic, published 2026-09-16 (https://www.placer.ai/anchor/articles/three-takes-on-value-how-dardens-casual-dining-brands-keep-visits-growing): Olive Garden, LongHorn and Cheddar's had positive YoY visits every month from April to August 2026. It is a narrow proxy, and it is contradicted by KeyBanc's card-spend data (https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/keybanc-reiterates-overweight-on-darden-stock-cites-olive-garden-improvement-93CH-4849960, 2026-09-23), which cut Olive Garden to +1.3%. Dropped.

Diesel and energy shock (https://weeklydiesel.com/history/2026/): $4.83/gal at the June 22 guide, then $6.53 by 2026-09-21, with an oil and Iran-war supply disruption. This is macro transmission with no company or counterparty statement, and Darden has said gas and its sales are not strongly correlated (https://www.thestreet.com/investing/stocks/dividend-paying-restaurant-darden-dri-stock-stumbles-as-higher-gas-prices-slow-consumer-spending). Skew and run-up already lean this way. Dropped.

Beef: the USDA Choice cutout was about $390 in late August and $376 on 2026-09-21, against $370-406 in September 2025 (https://www.indexbox.io/blog/usda-national-daily-boxed-beef-cutout-report-for-september-22-2026/). Roughly flat YoY, which is consistent with management's Q2 beef-deflation assumption and Oppenheimer's 'moderating beef'. Priced.

Peers: Texas Roadhouse Q2 (beef inflation peaked, 2026 commodity guide cut to ~5%), Brinker Q4 (Chili's +6%, July accelerating) and Cracker Barrel Q4 (comps -2.1%, reported 2026-09-23). All are wire copy, and none reads through specifically to Darden's quarter beyond what the previews already carry.

EDGAR since 2026-06-01: the 10-K of 2026-07-24, the proxy, and routine Form 4 and 144 filings (the July officer sales at ~$210 after the window opened, e.g. the Chief People Officer). No quiet 8-K, and no insider cluster of interest.

Olive Garden promotion calendar: the Never Ending Pasta Bowl and Pasta Pass start 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-31, essentially after the Q1 close (~2026-08-30). They matter only for Q2-to-date commentary, which the KeyBanc card data already flags as improving.
baseline_tension: Nothing found cuts against the baseline: the skew's paid downside and the soft 20-day run-up already reflect the fuel and consumer shock and the Olive Garden softness, and the lowered Olive Garden whisper plus a guide that brackets consensus are symmetric enough that the price already has all of this.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (narrow proxy loses to a broader or more direct series) plus rule 3 (own caveat must reach the number): dropped the +0.6 Olive Garden finding. Placer foot traffic was the whole finding, the published card-spend data contradicts it, and the lowered whisper it leaned on is sell-side wire copy.

Rule 5 (macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company or a counterparty says it) plus rule 7 (a finding that agrees with the skew is probably priced): dropped the -0.4 energy-shock guidance-risk finding.

Rule 6: the bar sits inside the company's own Q1 EPS cadence guide, so a print on consensus is something the market was told to expect. print_vs_bar trimmed from +0.3 to +0.2 and expected_move set to 0 with an empty findings list.
